svg.text: Boundary observations; allocation-cap row uses a separate explicit 256 MiB configuration.
Cell color — per-probe observation category (not a security rating):
Color describes this probe only, not overall security.
'repeat rejected' does not imply a general memory bound — each label describes only its own probe.
Allocation completion does not establish absence of a memory limit.
Different destination from container loopback. Not a container escape.
Not tested: Kernel or interpreter escapes; Cross-tenant access; Prompt injection attack success rate; Secret exfiltration and encoded/redirection variants; Signed or complete audit evidence;
Effect-level HTTP success for all backends; General memory bounds beyond the explicit capped probe
